# Research settings (generated reference)

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from ait/config/settings.py, config.yaml and config_research.yaml; edit the code, not this file -->

Every setting under `backtest` and `parity`: the research engine, learner, optimizer and parity tools. The sections research shares with the live bot (`ml`, `regime`, `meta_label`, `exit`, `options`, ...) are in [SETTINGS_LIVE.md](SETTINGS_LIVE.md); research reads them from `config.yaml`, and a study or `config_research.yaml` overrides only the keys it names. The *Shipped* column is the value research runs with: the overlay's value when `config_research.yaml` sets the key, else `config.yaml`'s, else the schema default. How the layers combine: [RESEARCH_GUIDE.md](../RESEARCH_GUIDE.md#4-configuration-where-every-value-lives).

193 settings; 0 have no description in the schema yet (shown as `-`).

| `backtest.spread_tuning.wing_expected_move_fraction` | `float` | 0.0 - 5.0 | 0.5 | 0.5 | config_research.yaml | Wing width of the iron butterfly, put / call credit spreads and jade lizard = wing_k x expected move x this (floored at the wing floor). 0.5 = half an expected move. |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.put_skew_coefficient` | `float` | 0.0 - 2.0 | 0.1 | 0.1 | config_research.yaml | Legacy put-skew term of the leg-IV model: skew_factor x (log-moneyness OTM) x this. |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.call_skew_coefficient` | `float` | 0.0 - 2.0 | 0.02 | 0.02 | config_research.yaml | Call-skew term of the leg-IV model: skew_factor x max(0, ln(K/S)) x this. |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.iv_rank_rise_lookback_rows` | `int` | 2 - 252 | 11 | 11 | config_research.yaml | Rows of the feature IV rank the rise veto looks at: the veto compares the last value with the one this many rows back minus one (11 rows = a 10-day rise). |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.vol_gate_lookback_rows` | `int` | 3 - 252 | 11 | 11 | config_research.yaml | Rows of closes the realized-vol entry gate measures (11 closes = 10 daily returns). |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.min_history_bars` | `int` | 5 - 252 | 20 | 20 | config_research.yaml | The engine takes no decision before this many bars of history (the larger of this and backtest.context_bars is skipped at the start). |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.fallback_iv` | `float` | 0.01 - 3.0 | 0.25 | 0.25 | config_research.yaml | The annualized volatility the engine assumes when it has nothing better: a position that carries no entry_iv (exit repricing, half-spread model) and a realized-vol estimate with too few prices. |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.drawdown_high_lookback_rows` | `int` | 2 - 1000 | 60 | 60 | config_research.yaml | Window (rows of daily closes) of the rolling high the drawdown entry gate measures the fall from (backtest.pct_from_60d_high_threshold); fewer rows are used while the history is shorter. |
| `backtest.engine_tuning.replay_lookback_days` | `int` | 0 - 3650 | 60 | 60 | config_research.yaml | Calendar days of history the single-trade replay (backtesting/replay.py) gives the engine in front of the trade's entry date. 60 calendar days is about 42 trading rows, so a replayed engine's gates that look back further than that (the drawdown gate's 60 rows) run on a shorter history than in a full run. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.warm_start_min_win_rate` | `float` | 0.0 - 1.0 | 0.75 | 0.75 | config_research.yaml | A window's Optuna study is warm-started from the PRIOR window's best parameters only if that window's out-of-sample win rate was at least this (else from the global best). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.warm_start_min_trades` | `int` | 0 - 100 | 3 | 3 | config_research.yaml | The prior window must also have had at least this many out-of-sample trades for its parameters to seed the next window's search. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.range_threshold_multiplier` | `float` | 0.0 - 5.0 | 1.25 | 1.25 | config_research.yaml | Adaptive range threshold = realized vol x sqrt(horizon/252) x this (about 1.25 standard deviations). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.range_threshold_low_clip` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.5 | 0.02 | 0.02 | config_research.yaml | Lower clip of the adaptive range threshold. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.range_threshold_high_clip` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.9 | 0.15 | 0.15 | config_research.yaml | Upper clip of the adaptive range threshold. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.range_threshold_lookback_days` | `int` | 10 - 504 | 60 | 60 | config_research.yaml | Trailing days of training data the adaptive threshold's realized vol uses. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.range_threshold_min_observations` | `int` | 2 - 504 | 10 | 10 | config_research.yaml | Fewer return observations than this and the threshold falls back. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.range_threshold_fallback` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.5 | 0.05 | 0.05 | config_research.yaml | The fixed +/- containment band used when the adaptive threshold cannot be computed (= live's range-model band). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.optimize_val_split_ratio` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.5 | 0.2 | 0.2 | config_research.yaml | Fraction of an Optuna training window held out as validation when the objective is scored on a validation slice (H2). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.inert_probe_iv_fallback` | `float` | 0.0 - 2.0 | 0.15 | 0.15 | config_research.yaml | IV assumed by the 'is wing_k inert' probe when the data carries no implied vol. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.inert_probe_iv_quantile` | `float` | 0.0 - 1.0 | 0.1 | 0.1 | config_research.yaml | Quantile of the data's IV the probe uses (the low end: the narrowest wing the study needs). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.inert_probe_dte_fallback` | `int` | 1 - 60 | 21 | 21 | config_research.yaml | Entry DTE the probe assumes when no settings are loaded. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.optimize_seed` | `int` | 0 - 2147483647 | 42 | 42 | config_research.yaml | Seed of the Optuna TPE sampler (the walk-forward's per-window studies and a bare StrategyOptimizer). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.train_days` | `int` | 60 - 3650 | 365 | 365 | config_research.yaml | Calendar days of each walk-forward TRAINING window (also the StrategyOptimizer's history window). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.test_days` | `int` | 5 - 730 | 63 | 63 | config_research.yaml | Calendar days of each out-of-sample TEST window (~3 months). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.step_days` | `int` | 1 - 730 | 63 | 63 | config_research.yaml | Calendar days the window slides forward. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.gap_days` | `int` | 0 - 90 | 5 | 5 | config_research.yaml | Purge gap between the end of training and the start of the test window. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.optimize_n_trials` | `int` | 1 - 5000 | 50 | 50 | config_research.yaml | Optuna trials per walk-forward window when --optimize-per-window is on. --optimize-n-trials overrides it for one run. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.optimizer_n_trials` | `int` | 1 - 5000 | 100 | 100 | config_research.yaml | Optuna trials of a standalone StrategyOptimizer / run_optimizer.py run (--n-trials overrides). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.min_train_rows` | `int` | 10 - 2000 | 50 | 50 | config_research.yaml | A symbol with fewer training-window bars than this is skipped for the window (no model can be trained on it). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.min_test_rows` | `int` | 1 - 500 | 5 | 5 | config_research.yaml | A symbol with fewer test-window bars than this is skipped for the window. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.context_padding_days` | `int` | 0 - 5000 | 900 | 900 | config_research.yaml | Extra calendar days of VIX / SPY context loaded before the training window so the slowest feature windows are warm (context = train_days + this). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.context_span_padding_days` | `int` | 0 - 5000 | 400 | 400 | config_research.yaml | When a research history span is configured, the context loaded before the training window is the whole span plus this many days. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.fetch_padding_days` | `int` | 0 - 1000 | 100 | 100 | config_research.yaml | Calendar days added to train_days + test_days when fetching the price history (a margin for weekends, holidays and feature warm-up). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.history_span_padding_days` | `int` | 0 - 365 | 30 | 30 | config_research.yaml | Calendar days added to the configured research-history span when sizing the price fetch. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.oos_direction_return_threshold` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.5 | 0.02 | 0.02 | config_research.yaml | The forward return that separates bullish / neutral / bearish when the out-of-sample DIRECTION model is scored (a diagnostic; it does not change any trade). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.oos_calibration_bins` | `int` | 2 - 50 | 8 | 8 | config_research.yaml | Confidence bins of the out-of-sample direction-model reliability chart. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.prob_score_bins` | `int` | 2 - 50 | 9 | 9 | config_research.yaml | Probability bins of the out-of-sample range-model reliability chart. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.oos_min_extra_rows` | `int` | 0 - 500 | 20 | 20 | config_research.yaml | The out-of-sample direction evaluation needs this many bars beyond its label horizon. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.oos_min_labelled_rows` | `int` | 2 - 500 | 10 | 10 | config_research.yaml | The out-of-sample direction evaluation also needs this many labelled rows, else it reports nothing for the window. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.oos_range_min_extra_rows` | `int` | 0 - 500 | 5 | 5 | config_research.yaml | The out-of-sample RANGE evaluation needs this many bars beyond its label horizon. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.min_windows` | `int` | 1 - 100 | 3 | 3 | config_research.yaml | A walk-forward run with fewer windows than this aborts (and run_backtest.py warns that too few windows produced results): too few to judge anything. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.window_score_full_credit_trades` | `int` | 1 - 500 | 5 | 5 | config_research.yaml | A window's score for the global best parameters is win rate x sqrt(min(1, trades / this)), so a window with fewer trades than this counts for proportionally less. |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.oos_feature_context_bars` | `int` | 20 - 2000 | 252 | 252 | config_research.yaml | Bars of the training window's tail that are put in front of each out-of-sample test window so the features have their look-back (capped at the training window's length, so early windows still run). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.meta_label_min_window_rows` | `int` | 1 - 5000 | 60 | 60 | config_research.yaml | The meta-labeler is trained for a window only when the training window has MORE than this many bars (otherwise the window runs without one). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.min_fetched_rows` | `int` | 0 - 10000 | 100 | 100 | config_research.yaml | A symbol is used by a walk-forward run only when MORE than this many daily bars were fetched for it (fewer is treated as no data). |
| `backtest.walkforward_tuning.min_backtest_rows` | `int` | 4 - 5000 | 60 | 60 | config_research.yaml | The optimizer's minimum number of daily bars. |
| `backtest.dte_search.enabled` | `bool` | - | false | false | neither (schema default) | Add the DTE dimensions to the iron-condor search. |
| `backtest.dte_search.entry_dte` | `list[int]` | - | [0, 45] | [0, 45] | neither (schema default) | Inclusive range of the searched entry DTE (calendar days). |
| `backtest.dte_search.guard_dte` | `list[int]` | - | [0, 5] | [0, 5] | neither (schema default) | Inclusive range of the searched expiry_guard_dte: entries with at most this many DTE are exempt from live rules 3/3a (the close at DTE<=5). 0-5 spans 'rules apply to everything' to 'every short entry is exempt'. |
| `backtest.dte_search.hold_fraction` | `list[float]` | - | [0.05, 1.0] | [0.05, 1.0] | neither (schema default) | Range of the searched max_hold_fraction: close after this share of the position's own life. 1.0 = hold to expiry (or the flatten). |
| `backtest.dte_search.search_flatten` | `bool` | - | false | false | neither (schema default) | Also search flatten_minutes_before_close. |
| `backtest.dte_search.flatten_minutes` | `list[int]` | - | [30, 120] | [30, 120] | neither (schema default) | Range of the searched flatten (minutes before the close) when search_flatten is on. |
| `backtest.dte_search.multivariate` | `bool` | - | false | false | neither (schema default) | TPESampler(multivariate=True, group=True). |
| `backtest.dte_search.strict` | `bool` | - | false | false | neither (schema default) | A per-window optimisation that FAILS aborts the study instead of silently falling back to the base config. |
| `backtest.pin_band_usd` | `float` | 0.0 - 1.0 | 0.1 | 0.1 | neither (schema default) | A SHORT leg within this many dollars of its strike at the expiry bell is a pin: whether it is assigned cannot be known at the close, so the engine scores both outcomes and books the worse (assumption A5 of the short-DTE programme). |
| `backtest.assignment_fee_per_share` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.1 | 0.015 | 0.015 | neither (schema default) | $/share charged on stock delivered by ASSIGNMENT at expiry. |
| `backtest.stock_commission_per_share` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.1 | 0.01 | 0.01 | neither (schema default) | $/share to close shares left over after a one-sided expiry at the next session's open. |
| `backtest.iv_rank_rise_gate` | `bool` | - | true | false | config_research.yaml | Apply the IV-rank RISE veto at all. |
| `backtest.iv_rank_rise_threshold` | `float` | 0.0 - 10.0 | 0.3 | 0.3 | config.yaml | Suppress iron-condor entry when IV rank rose more than this over the last 10 days (Exp 20 veto). |
| `backtest.regime_veto_gate` | `bool` | - | true | true | neither (schema default) | Apply the trending-down REGIME veto at all. |
| `backtest.regime_down_threshold` | `float` | -0.5 - 0.0 | -0.05 | -0.05 | neither (schema default) | Price_vs_sma_20 below this (with vol_regime_expanding) classes a day 'trending_down' in the research engine: the regime veto, the entry_regime stored on each position and the meta-label regime features all read it. |
| `backtest.regime_up_threshold` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.5 | 0.02 | 0.02 | neither (schema default) | Price_vs_sma_20 above this (with vol_regime_expanding) classes a day 'trending_up' in the research engine (position entry_regime and the meta-label regime features; it never vetoes). |
| `backtest.ex_div_entry_gate` | `Literal['off', 'live', 'exact', 'last_k_days']` | - | off | live | config_research.yaml | The research TWIN of live's ex-dividend entry block: refuse a new position that SELLS A CALL when an ex-dividend date falls between the entry day and the position's expiry (early-assignment risk on the short call). 'live' = live's rule exactly: ONE projected ex-date (dividends.project_next_ex_div over the ex-dates known before the entry day). 'exact' = any real ex-date in [entry, expiry]. 'last_k_days' = only a real… |
| `backtest.ex_div_entry_k_days` | `int` | 1 - 30 | 5 | 5 | neither (schema default) | K for ex_div_entry_gate 'last_k_days': block only when a real ex-date is at most K calendar days before the position's expiry. |
| `backtest.min_edge_over_baseline` | `float` | 0.0 - 1.0 | 0.05 | 0.05 | config.yaml | Minimum weighted CV edge over the base rate for the range predictor to activate as an entry gate (Exp 28 quality floor; 0.0 = always use the model). |
| `backtest.slippage_pct` | `float` | 0.0 - 0.1 | 0.01 | 0.01 | config.yaml | Fractional price slippage the research engine adds on top of the modeled spread for DEBIT / long-option structures (long call/put, straddles, debit spreads). |
| `backtest.delta_short` | `float` | 0.05 - 0.5 | 0.2 | 0.2 | config.yaml | \|delta\| the research engine targets for the SHORT strikes of its structures. |
| `backtest.delta_long` | `float` | 0.05 - 0.6 | 0.3 | 0.3 | config.yaml | \|delta\| the research engine targets for LONG single options and long legs of debit structures. |
| `backtest.hurst_hard_veto_multiplier` | `float` | 0.0 - 5.0 | 1.5 | 1.5 | config.yaml | Legacy derivation of the fractal HARD veto when fractal_veto_spread is unset: veto spread = max(hurst_regime_threshold, 0.20) x this. 0 = no derived veto. |
| `backtest.pct_from_60d_high_threshold` | `float` | -1.0 - 0.0 | -1.0 | -1.0 | config.yaml | Research-only experimental entry gate: refuse a neutral credit entry when spot is more than this fraction below its 60-day high (e.g. -0.05). -1.0 = DISABLED (the default; values <= -0.99 never gate). |
| `backtest.skew_factor` | `float` | 0.0 - 5.0 | 1.0 | 1.0 | config.yaml | Multiplier on the engine's legacy flat IV-skew term (put 0.10 / call 0.02 per unit log-moneyness). 0.0 = flat IV. Additive with skew_slope_per_pct_otm, the measured steepening. |
| `backtest.context_bars` | `int` | 0 - 1000 | 0 | 0 | config.yaml | Extra intraday bars of lookback the research engine keeps as feature context (lookback = max(20, this)). 0 = the engine minimum. |

## Research parity replay (`parity`)

| Setting | Type | Allowed range | Default | Shipped | Listed in | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parity.credit_error_pct_max` | `float` | 0.0 - 1.0 | 0.15 | 0.15 | config_research.yaml | Median \|modelled - actual\| entry credit, as a fraction of the actual credit, above which a DTE band FAILS parity. |
| `parity.credit_bias_pct_max` | `float` | 0.0 - 1.0 | 0.1 | 0.1 | config_research.yaml | \|median signed error\| / actual credit above which a band FAILS. Separate from the spread check on purpose: a model that is consistently 8% rich passes the spread test and still manufactures a fake edge in every study. |
| `parity.min_trades_per_band` | `int` | 1 - 1000 | 3 | 3 | config_research.yaml | A DTE band with fewer closed trades than this is reported INSUFFICIENT instead of PASS/FAIL. The replay set is small (tens of trades), so small bands are common and a verdict on two trades would be noise presented as a result. |
| `parity.dte_band_upper_edges` | `list[int]` | - | [2, 7, 14, 45] | [2, 7, 14, 45] | config_research.yaml | Inclusive upper edges (calendar DTE at entry) of the parity bands: [2, 7, 14, 45] gives 0-2, 3-7, 8-14, 15-45 and a trailing 46+ catch-all. |
